regions.merged_text: Dear Sister Mary Berita: God bless you and yours. I just finished your letter of March 10th and am inscribing the name of Mr. James Peters as a member in the Seraphic Mass Association which I trust may help him some- way. This in fact is the secret of the wonderful prayers they were tell- ing you about in Barclay Street, New York. The following will interest Mr.Peters and his friends. This is taken from "Notes and Favors" I have been making now and then for years.

regions.merged_text: "Mrs. Catherine Nagle - 45 -- mother of eight children having been found so full of cancer when opened up for operation two weeks ago (May 9th) that the doctor sewed her up with out further attempt to help her, lamenting that she'd never leave the hospital alive(Providence) "Having enrolled her in the Seraphic Mass Association, her husband asked: "IS there anything else I could do for her?" "I suggested that he enroll the Poor Souls - having his own deceased relatives specially in mind" . "That's good", he said offering a special donation .. . whole Family storm- ing Heaven by daily Communion." ."Leaving Hospital To-day, though unable to take any nourish't ****

regions.merged_text: Dear Sister: I hope this may give you all a little more courage to pray on and with your friends, storm Heaven. I often advise a proposition to the Poor souls; viz, that if an operation is averted, e.g., they donate an enrollment for the Poor Souls "of the operation averted - or charity to some good cause, and besides prayers and Holy Communions, etc.
